SOGROM_DICETRAY.Title: Dice Tray
SOGROM_DICETRAY.SettingShowHint: Set Dice Tray to be visible by default.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.SettingThemeHint: Choose the visual theme for the dice tray.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.SettingExtraDiceHint: Adds a second row of less common dice to every player's tray: d2, d3, d5, d7, d14, d16, d24 and d30.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.SettingPopoutButtonHint: Where the button that opens the dice tray in its own window appears in the scene controls on the left.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.SettingPopoutAutoOpen: Open the Pop-out Tray on Load
SOGROM_DICETRAY.SettingPopoutAutoOpenHin: Opens the dice tray in its own window whenever you join the world.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.SettingRightClickHint: What right-clicking a die in the tray does: take one of that die out of the pool, or roll a single one of that die straight away without changing the pool.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.KeybindingToggleTray: Show or Hide the Dice Tray
SOGROM_DICETRAY.KeybindingToggleTrayHint: The same as clicking the d20 button above the chat input.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.KeybindingTogglePopout: Open or Close the Pop-out Tray
SOGROM_DICETRAY.KeybindingTogglePopoutHi: Shows the dice tray in its own window, which you can move anywhere on screen.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.KeybindingRollPoolHint: Rolls the dice you have added to the tray, as if you clicked Roll.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.KeybindingClearPoolHint: Empties the tray: dice, keep modifiers, roll mode and modifier.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.EmptyPool: Add some dice to your pool first!
SOGROM_DICETRAY.RollError: Invalid dice formula. Please check your input.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.CommandError: The chat command {command} failed. Check the console (F12) for details.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.TooltipModifierInput: Modifier: type a number, or scroll to change it. Enter rolls.
